wetness.source: NOAA MRMS MultiSensor QPE 24H Pass2, District 3 mean; NRCS NEH-4 table 4.2 classes

snodas.source: NOHRSC SNODAS daily (06 UTC), masked CONUS 30 arc-s, via NSIDC G02158 (https://nsidc.org/data/g02158)

soil.source: NOAA National Water Model v3 operational analysis (analysis_assim, land, tm00): SOILSAT_TOP, fraction of saturation of the top 40 cm of soil, 1 km, District 3 mean
soil.clim_source: NWM v3.0 retrospective (AWS noaa-nwm-retrospective-3-0-pds, CONUS/zarr/ldasout.zarr), SOIL_M layers 1-2 (0.1 / 0.3 m) / operational porosity per cell (= SOILSAT_TOP scale), daily mean of the 3-hourly District 3 box mean (lat (41.98, 42.75), lon (-72.25, -71.25)), 1979-02-01..2023-02-01, +-15 days of the date
soil.clim_note: Percentile of the operational value among retrospective days; the two runs differ in forcing, so read it as approximate.

model_use: Shown for context only. The live forecast runs at the calibrated normal ground; the 5-day wetness rule lowered skill in the 23 Oct 2026 backtest (docs/proto/runoff/AMC.md) and frozen ground is not yet backtested. Wet or frozen ground means the forecast is likely too low.
